settings.title: We go to the source.
settings.text: Altura started in 2016 with one farm, one roaster and a simple idea: the people who grow extraordinary coffee should be paid like it.

settings.title: No middlemen. No mystery.
settings.text:
We travel to every farm we buy from, every harvest. We cup the coffee together, agree on a price before it's picked and pay growers directly — on average 2.4× the fair-trade minimum.

That price funds new drying beds, better processing and school fees. It also means we get first pick of the very best lots.

settings.title: One farm, one roaster
settings.text: We roast our first 60 kg from a single farm in Villa Rica in a borrowed 5 kg roaster.

settings.title: The roastery opens
settings.text: Our café and roastery opens in Miraflores, Lima. Wholesale to the first 10 cafés.

settings.title: Direct trade, everywhere
settings.text: Every coffee we sell is bought directly from the grower at a pre-agreed price.

settings.title: Compostable everything
settings.text: All bags become home-compostable; shipping becomes carbon-neutral.

settings.title: 42 farms, 5 regions
settings.text: Coffee from Cajamarca to Puno, shipped to 40+ countries.

settings.title: Roasted in small batches in Lima
settings.text: We roast on a 15 kg drum roaster twice a week, profiling every coffee to bring out its origin — never to hide it.
